info.title: Flare named-token API
info.summary: Account-scoped file uploads, file metadata, short links, and outbound file-ready events.
info.description: Documents the current unversioned routes in Flare, not an /api/v1 prefix. Replace the server URL with your own instance. Only named-token-supported endpoints appear under paths; browser-session/admin routes are documented separately. In particular, /api/saved-views and /api/saved-views/{id} require a browser session and reject bearer credentials, so they are not operations in this document. Bearer tokens use application scopes, not OAuth. Upload sizes are bytes; list-file sizes are MiB. Some responses intentionally omit success or data wrappers. The info version versions this document; webhook payload version is independently 1.

servers.description: Replace with your Flare instance origin.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Own-account uploads and metadata. Named tokens do not authorize private content downloads or file deletion.

get.description: Requires the files:read scope. Pagination is offset-based except for image-anchor requests. File sizes in this response are MiB, not bytes. Results include only this account and use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

401.description: Missing/invalid/revoked/expired token, missing required scope, or required email verification.

400.description: Invalid request/options, part list, file type, or expiration.

404.description: Owned resource or upload session not found.

500.description: The operation could not be completed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Positive page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Positive integer. Values above 100 are capped at 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive filename or OCR-text match.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order; unknown values fall back to newest.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact MIME types, for example image/png,image/jpeg.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive uploaded-at lower bound; use an ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound. A date-only value includes the final day in server-local time; explicit timestamps preserve their instant.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Comma-separated public, private, hasPassword. Conditions within this filter are ORed.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Owned folder ID or unfiled. Direct folder membership, without descendants.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Owned tag ID or untagged. Excluded tags do not count.

parameters.name: galleryAnchor
parameters.description: Image file ID in the current filter; requires galleryDirection. Returns adjacent images, excluding anchor.

parameters.name: galleryDirection
parameters.description: Requires galleryAnchor. Anchored responses include pagination.offset and only image files.

post.description: Requires the files:upload scope. Stream one multipart file. Select profile/folder in headers or query and naming in profile/account defaults before sending bytes. All upload limits and quota apply; administrators are exempt from the default quota but not file-size limits. No multipart idempotency key is implemented.

post.description: Outbound request to your configured receiver, not an endpoint hosted by Flare. Validate HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + dot + exact raw body using the full whsec_ secret. Deduplicate stable event IDs. Five total attempts; retry delays 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, 2 hours. 2xx acknowledges; 408/429/5xx and connection failures retry. Other 3xx/4xx fail without retry. Queue capacity can skip events; file-access changes can cancel them. file.ready does not imply OCR completion.

parameters.name: X-Flare-Event-Id
parameters.description: Stable event ID; must equal body.id.

parameters.name: X-Flare-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds for this attempt. Reject stale/future requests outside your accepted clock window.

parameters.name: X-Flare-Signature
parameters.description: v1= plus lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256. Compare in constant time against the original body bytes.

requestBody.description: At most 64 KiB. Tests add test: true and use test: event IDs; they do not create a file.

2XX.description: Event durably accepted (for example 204). Duplicate accepted events should also return 2xx.

429.description: Throttled; retry on Flare fixed schedule.

default.description: Other 3xx/4xx permanently fail this automatic cycle. Redirects are not followed.

BearerAuth.description: Named API token from Profile → Integrations. Select files:read, files:upload, urls:read, urls:write as needed. Required scope is recorded in each operation description and x-flare-scope; HTTP bearer security arrays are empty because this is not OAuth. Missing scopes produce 401.

Error.description: Upload/authentication failures use this shape; no success property is required.

UploadLinks.description: URLs follow sharing access rules; they are not private-file access grants. url and copyText alias pageUrl. name is the display name; type is the MIME type.

visibility.description: Public without a profile override. Private content requires an eligible browser session; this bearer token does not authorize content downloads.
